Hi Elsa — thanks for sending these. A few notes from procurement/AP side so we can avoid delays: 

1) Reverse-charge: For EU suppliers with a valid VAT ID billing to Redwood EU legal entity (Redwood Inference Europe AB), we typically apply the reverse-charge mechanism on our VAT returns and therefore expect invoices to be issued VAT-net (no VAT line) with the supplier's VAT ID visible and a statement: "Reverse charge applies under Article 194 VAT Directive". If you issue VAT-inclusive invoices, AP will need to request a credit invoice and a corrected VAT-net invoice.

2) PO matching & GRN: Our AP system requires either a) a GRN or b) a delivery confirmation email from the Redwood project owner with the PO number and delivered quantity. For initial shipments we do ask for GRN to expedite three-way match exceptions. If you can send a signed GRN or a scanned delivery note referencing PO RINF-4578, that will help.

3) Early-payment discounts: We process discounts as payment terms on the invoice and do not create separate credit notes in most cases. From a VAT perspective, the invoice should show the gross amount and the discount as an explicit line so our VAT team can reflect the net taxable base correctly.

I'm looping in Monica (AP) and Lauren (Tax Ops) to confirm the exact text we need on the invoice.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
